stages.name: spec-lint
details: [LINT-HY-007] hypotheses[6].description: Hypothesis appears to describe what will NOT be built; hypotheses must be affirmative and testable

five_fields.statement: Expressions with exactly 5 whitespace-separated fields are parsed; any other count is rejected naming the count.

syntax_forms.statement: *, single values, lists, ranges and steps (*/n, a-b/n, a/n) parse to the expected value sets within bounds.

names.statement: JAN-DEC and SUN-SAT are accepted case-insensitively, in lists and ranges; day 7 equals Sunday.

validate_explains.statement: validate on a valid expression prints one explanation line per field (minute, hour, day-of-month, month, day-of-week) and exits 0.

validate_errors.statement: validate on out-of-range, malformed, zero-step or reversed-range input prints an error naming the field and exits non-zero.

next_runs.statement: next -n N from a fixed reference time yields N ascending times strictly after it that match the expression; default N is 5.
must_include: next prints next N run times

invalid_dates.statement: 0 0 30 2 * never yields Feb 30 and is reported as never matching; 0 0 29 2 * yields only leap-year Feb 29; 31 in 30-day months is skipped.

single_file_stdlib.statement: cron_parser.py imports only standard library modules and runs as a script with python3 cron_parser.py.
